> [!IMPORTANT]
> All commits must be signed and verified. Pull requests containing unsigned or unverified commits cannot be built or merged. See the [GitHub documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/authentication/managing-commit-signature-verification/about-commit-signature-verification) for instructions.
>
> For all but trivial fixes, make sure to first create a GitHub issue that concisely describes the bug or desired enhancement as justification for the change. Large PRs with no justifying issue will be closed.

## Adding New Models

We welcome new model contributions, provided that the model's license permits such use and redistribution. In general, models under BSD, MIT, Apache 2.0, and Creative Commons (CC0, CC BY 3.0, CC BY 4.0) are good candidates for acceptance. Models under a custom license receive more scrutiny and may be declined depending on the license terms.

When bringing up a new model, please share your example runtime output and performance benchmark results. We are happy to work with you to maintain a high bar for accepted models.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Small feature (agreed in an issue)
- [ ] New model (export recipe only)
- [ ] New model (export recipe and new runtime support)
- [ ] Documentation update
